mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtered fluid through the recovery tube was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys take useful substances back rather than simply filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters was predictable and added little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The filter lets useful glucose and water through along with waste, so recovery matters.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though fitting the organs was straightforward and largely guided by their names and pictures.

continue.text: I would probably continue: following filtering and recovery made a familiar organ's job clearer, though the simple fittings were less engaging.
